algorithm: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor (absolute-error loss), target = yield / district 5-year mean

data.source: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, district-wise area, production and yield (1997-98 to 2022-23; 2024-25)
data.cleaning: reported area >= 200 ha, positive yield, yield <= 4x the crop's 99th percentile

splits.out_of_time: 2024-25 district file, forecast from records up to 2022-23 (two years ahead)
splits.leakage_control: every feature is computed only from years before the forecast cutoff

served_forecast.rule: per crop, the candidate (model, model/5-year-mean blend, district 5-year mean) with the lowest median error on validation at the two-year horizon

limits: District averages across all farms; an individual field can differ widely with water, variety and management.
No in-season weather: the forecast is made before the season from past yields.
2023-24 district records are missing from the source files, so recent forecasts look two or more years ahead.
Districts that changed name or were split are matched by name; unmatched fields fall back to the state average.
